article.body:
ArXiv listing identifies paper on adversarial MDP policy optimization

The arXiv cs.LG record lists “Closing the Horizon Gap in Policy Optimization for Adversarial MDPs.” The supplied evidence establishes a research-paper listing, not a policy decision, procurement action or operational capability. It provides no abstract, results or implementation details, so it does not establish what method was developed or whether any organisation can use it.
